metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for analyzr, the headless store for BPMN process landscapes.

plugins.name: analyzr
plugins.description: The analyzr pipeline procedures as skills: /analyzr:relations judges candidate relations between BPMN processes, /analyzr:placements places processes on the value chain. Connect the analyzr MCP server separately.

plugins.name: analyzr-integrate
plugins.description: Interactive skills that bring customer process landscapes into analyzr: /analyzr-integrate:integrate-landscape turns a BPMN 2.0 export (Signavio, ARIS, ADONIS, Bizagi, …) into an import bundle and a German report; the consultant runs the import. Needs a shell and Node 24.
